title: Grouping feature like with macOS Stacks
line: The desktop can now group files of the same type into stacks, and clicking a stack shows its files in a popup.
explanation: Folder View had no way to group a messy desktop: every file was its own icon. This adds a "Stack Files by Type" option (desktop right-click menu > Icons, and the Icons settings page, off by default). When it's on, files of the same kind (images, videos, audio, documents, other files) collapse into one stack icon drawn as a small pile, folders and launchers stay as they are, and a kind with a single file shows that file. Clicking a stack opens the same popup used for folder previews, filtered to that stack's files, where they can be opened, dragged, renamed or deleted as usual; stacks update live as files come and go.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: add an option to stack files by type

With the new Stack Files by Type option, desktop files of the same kind
(images, videos, audio, documents, others) collapse into one stack, like
macOS Stacks. Clicking a stack shows its files in a folder-style popup.

BUG: 430983
